title: onthisday signal
description: 'On this day' from Wikipedia: for lang 'ja' the ja.wikipedia day article (できごと + Japanese 記念日), otherwise the Wikimedia onthisday feed. Fetched once per local day (retried every 10 min until it works). GET /api/signals/onthisday, polled every 10 min; 404 unless providers.onthisday.enabled (opt-in network); null until the first fetch. Text is CC BY-SA (Wikipedia). Not sensitive.

events.description: Historical events of this day, oldest first.

year.description: Year (may be small for ancient events).
